_howToUpdate: Upload the clip to YouTube (unlisted works and keeps it out of search).
Paste the ID or the whole URL into youtubeId — youtu.be/, watch?v= and /shorts/ all work.
A clip still waiting to be uploaded can play from a local mp4 instead: "file": "images/x.mp4".
Delete that mp4 once the clip has an ID — youtubeId always wins over file.
